name: Klampt Robot Interface Layer pose-control example
summary: Guarded Python 3 Klampt example that opens a ghost-pose editor and sends moveToPosition through a selected Robot Interface Layer interface after an action. A configured hardware interface may command real motion; simulation-only behavior is not established.

license.scope: Upstream BSD-3-Clause declaration for the selected Python example only. Its pinned copyright line is incomplete: Copyright (c) 2018, with no holder. Attribution remains unresolved; no holder from the separate core repository is substituted. Models, meshes, configurations, controllers and third-party dependencies are outside this review.

requirements.python: Python 3.x (upstream directory declaration; exact version untested)
packages: Sibling kbdrive.py and its unreviewed loading dependencies
PyOpenGL and PyQt6 for visualization as declared by the reviewed core README
hardware: Separately authorized robot/controller if a hardware interface is selected
system: Working GUI and graphics environment for pose editing
Configured world/model, intended interface and any controller or robot-info inputs
requirements.notes: The main guard does not cover imports: kbdrive.load_world_and_interface is imported at module top level. That helper was located in the pinned tree but not fetched or reviewed; its loading behavior, import effects and dependencies remain unverified. The main code creates a simulated interface only when the helper returns none; otherwise it uses or wraps the supplied interface. It initializes that interface, reads positions, opens a ghost editor and can send moveToPosition after the registered action. TimedLooper uses the interface's control rate plus a 0.01-second sleep; neither timing nor real-time operation was measured. Normal loop exit closes the interface and viewer, without an encompassing try/finally guarantee. Models, assets, controllers and exact package/robot combinations were not reviewed or tested.

invocation.entrypoint: From Python3/demos/control: python pose.py world_file(s) [controller_file], or robotinfo_file [world_files]
invocation.notes: Upstream guarded main only after reviewing the full helper, dependencies, models and selected interface, with separate operator authorization for any hardware. This source may initialize a real controller and command motion; a simulation fallback does not establish simulator-only behavior. A lone copy of pose.py is insufficient. The Hub provides no preparation/execution adapter and contacted no controller, robot or simulator. Physical safety, controller compatibility and task success are unverified.

access.instructions: Read the pinned source, unresolved attribution note, helper and upstream setup before use. This reference does not install or execute code.

evidence.inspection: Complete selected source read as inert text; Python 3 AST and main guard checked without execution. Source, license declaration and README SHA-256, sizes and Git blobs matched the immutable nontruncated tree. Incomplete attribution and unread helper remain explicit. No upstream code, native package, interface, controller, robot or simulator was executed.
